payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into how the SubQG approach effectively handles noisy entity linking results in query generation for knowledge-based question answering.

claims.text: SubQG can generate correct answers in 85% of cases even with noisy entity/relation linking results by ranking query structures and filtering out errors through validation checks.
The approach utilizes multiple networks to learn predictors for different query substructures, allowing stable performance with limited training data and noisy linking results.

SubQG merges question-contained query substructures to build new query structures, which helps in generating executable queries despite the absence of structurally-equivalent queries in training data.
